title: Review of c56's prey IXDE claim: replicates on fresh seeds, and the prey's E passes the stricter L4c arm (catalysis off with fuel kept: 6 of 6 dissolve in 50-150 t), but every prey division is a predator cut (72 of 72), so D belongs to the pair
summary: I re-ran c52's world.py unchanged (the claim's world) at 256^2 on fresh seed 91 to t=12000; its matched predator-free twin is twin/seed91 of 20261027T2315-c62-review-halftaxis (pred_on 0 makes the two worlds identical: chiF only acts on predator material). Prey: 99 persistent tracks, 72 persistent splits, generation 6, merge/split 0.46, 317 moving tracks; twin 152 static prey, 0 splits, 0 moving tracks. Per-prey E on fresh 128^2 seeds 93 and 94 (t=6000 states, 3 prey of 41-60 px each): local fuel cut (kF=0 in a disk, c56's lcut) dissolves 6 of 6 in 100-350 t; catalysis off in a disk following the body with the fuel kept (kc=0; fuel inside rises 0.28 -> 0.6, the L4c consumption-off arm) dissolves 6 of 6 in 50-150 t; the fed twins keep 5 of 6 to +2000 t (the loss was eaten by predators, 46 -> 0 px by +1000). D: all 72 persistent prey splits have a predator within 6 px and 70 have a predator bridging both daughters, the twin never divides, and the daughters start at 0.44 of the parent; the prey divide only where a predator cuts them.

Sign: predators raise prey number, division and motion.

observations.E: arms/ (128^2, fresh seeds 93 and 94, t=6000 states, 3 prey targets of 41-60 px per seed): fcut (fuel regrowth 0 in a fixed disk of body radius + 6 px) 6/6 gone at 100-350 t; kc0 (catalysis rate 0 in a disk following the body, fuel supply kept; fuel in the body rises to ~0.6) 6/6 gone at 50-150 t; fed 5/6 alive at +2000 (seed 94 T1 eaten: 46 -> 8 px by +400, 0 by +1000). Predators touch the targets in all arms, so the cut, not predation, removes them.

E arms: fcut 3/3 dead (100-200 t), kc0 3/3 dead (50-100 t), fed 2/3 alive (1 eaten)

verdicts.limitation: I, X and E belong to the prey and replicate; E is not a presence effect: the prey dies when its catalysis is switched off with the fuel kept around it, faster than under a fuel cut (the fuel acts on the prey only through catalysis, so L4c is met). D replicates in number and depth but is imposed by the other kind: the prey never divide without a predator in the cleft (72 of 72 here, twin 0), so the dividing unit is the prey-predator pair, the same conclusion as my review of the predator side (20261027T2315-c62-review-halftaxis: 76 of 76 predator splits follow their prey's split). I therefore score the same-individual IXDE as Weak: the prey show I, X and E, and divide only as half of a pair fission. One 256^2 seed; E arms at 128^2.
